settings.title: Settings

shadowed.project: This project has its own value, so the change won't show here. Switch to "This project" to change it.
shadowed.global: Your all-projects value still applies here.
shadowed.env: An environment variable overrides this setting, so omp keeps using that value.

shadowed.overlay: A config overlay file overrides this setting.

help.always-ask: omp can look around on its own, but asks before it changes a file or runs a command.
help.write: omp can read and edit files on its own, but asks before running commands or starting helpers.
help.yolo: omp works on its own without asking. Only use this in projects you trust.
help.none: How much omp may do on its own before asking you.

transcript.label: Transcript view
transcript.description: Choose how much detail you see: just answers, plus thinking, or every step.

voice.label: Voice input
voice.description: Shows a microphone button in the message box so you can talk instead of type. omp turns your speech into text using the Dictation model.

compaction.label: Summarize long chats automatically
compaction.description: When a chat gets close to the model's limit, omp condenses the earlier part so you can keep going.

personality.label: omp's tone
personality.description: How omp talks to you in its replies.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: System follows your computer's light or dark setting.

textSize.label: Text size
textSize.description: Makes all text in the app bigger or smaller.
textSize.preview: omp fixed the coupon bug and ran the checkout tests — all 12 passed.

motion.title: Motion
motion.label: Reduce motion
motion.description: Turns off sliding, pulsing and shimmering effects.

permissions.intro: Choose, tool by tool, whether omp may use it without asking. Tools left on Default follow your permission mode (now: {{mode}}).
permissions.defaultHelp: Ask always checks with you first. Allow never asks. Deny blocks the tool completely.
permissions.unrecognized: omp ignores these entries because their value isn't Ask, Allow or Deny: {{tools}}

add.label: Another tool
add.description: Tools from connected services (MCP) and extensions can be listed here by name.

modelsTab.title: Models
modelsTab.description: The model that answers in new chats, and how hard it thinks.

defaultModel.label: Default model
defaultModel.description: Used for every chat unless you switch.

thinking.label: Default thinking
thinking.description: More thinking gives better answers to hard questions but takes longer and costs more.

roles.title: Model roles
roles.description: Pick which model does which job — everyday chat, planning, commit messages, and more.

alerts.title: Notifications
alerts.description: Get a desktop notification when omp needs you while the app is in the background.

notifications.label: Desktop notifications
notifications.description: Tells you when a chat finishes or omp is waiting for your answer.

roles.title: Model roles
roles.subtitle: Pick which model does which job — everyday chat, planning, commit messages, and more.
roles.autoHelp: omp picks a suitable model for this job automatically.
roles.missing: This model isn't available — pick another
roles.aliasHelp: This role uses whatever model {{alias}} is set to.
roles.overridden: This project sets its own model for this role ({{value}}), so it wins here. Switch to "This project" to change it.

usage.default: Every chat, unless you switch models.
usage.plan: Plan mode — working out an approach before any files change.
usage.commit: Writing commit messages and summaries of your changes.
usage.advisor: A second opinion that watches each step and adds notes when something looks off.
usage.smol: Quick, low-cost jobs where speed matters more than depth.
usage.slow: Hard problems that deserve slower, more careful thinking.
usage.vision: Understanding screenshots and pictures you add to a chat.
usage.tiny: Small background chores, like naming your chats. Uses the Fast model when empty.
usage.memory: Saving and recalling what omp remembers between chats. Uses the Tiny model when empty.
usage.task: Helpers omp starts to split a big job into smaller pieces.
usage.image: Creating pictures when you ask for one.
usage.web: Searching the web for up-to-date answers.
usage.dictation: Turning your voice into text in the message box.
usage.judge: Quick yes-or-no calls omp makes about its own work, like how hard to think about a request.
usage.custom: A role you added. Helpers and commands use it by writing @{{id}} as their model.

saveTo.project: Changes apply to this project only.

ai.title: Create a helper with AI
ai.body: Describe the specialist you want. omp writes the helper for you in a new chat.
ai.label: What should this helper do?
ai.placeholder: e.g. Review my changes for accessibility problems and suggest fixes in plain words.

ai.started: omp is creating your helper in a new chat.
ai.startedHint: Open Helpers again when it's done to see it.
